'''Blark''' was [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] soldier and weapon dealer who worked for the [[Organization]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

==Biography==
At some point of Blark's career, one of his cargoes was stolen near [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. Blark managed to see the thief, and held a grudge against him. In 32 BBY, Blark mistakenly believed to have seen the thief in [[Rothe Gate]], a weapon storage asteroid. Blark growled in [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriwook]] and attacked the suspect with his baton and a crew of four people. Nobody in the asteroid did anything except betting, and mostly against Blark. The other party was not his fugitive, but a considerably resourceful mercenary who had worked previously for [[Nirama]].
